3f3842.title: Scoped proxy connectivity gap
3f3842.content: Root verification using the injected `HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:48080` reached a 500 HTML response whose body explicitly contains `<title>Caido</title>` for both `http://172.23.0.2:5000/` and `https://172.23.0.2:5000/` (the HTTPS attempt includes proxy CONNECT 200 followed by 500). `aidast_list_captured_requests(host=172.23.0.2)` was empty after these requests. `httpx` likewise printed only Caido-identifying results and did not create AIDAST journal entries. This is recorded as a discovery-blocking proxy boundary mismatch; no application endpoint coverage may be inferred from it.

1538e2.title: Surface discovery blocked by enforced proxy for 172.23.0.2:5000
1538e2.content:
## Approved target
`http://172.23.0.2:5000/` only.

## Completed discovery attempts (all through injected proxy environment)
- `httpx` checked both `http://172.23.0.2:5000/` and `https://172.23.0.2:5000/`; each received `500`, `Content-Type: text/html`, 9088 bytes, title `Caido`.
- `curl` requested HTTP `/`, `/robots.txt`, and `/sitemap.xml`, plus HTTPS `/`; every response was the same `500` proxy-generated page (no target headers). HTTPS CONNECT returned a proxy `200 Connection established` followed by the same `500`.
- Bounded Katana crawls ran separately from HTTP and HTTPS root with JavaScript crawling and XHR extraction enabled (`-jc -xhr-extraction -d 2 -c 5 -p 3`); each emitted exactly one root GET, status `500`, and no discovered URL, parameter, form, script, XHR, redirect, or API evidence.
- `agent-browser` loaded both HTTP and HTTPS root. Each showed page title `Caido`, no interactive elements, and only requested root and `/favicon.ico`, all `500`.
- Scope-approved AIDAST request journal query for host `172.23.0.2` returned zero captured exchanges, so it cannot provide target-side corroboration.

## Observed proxy error body
`<title>Caido</title>` / `Proxy encountered an unhandled error` / `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database` / `Have you tried selecting a project first?`

## Discovery result and gap
No application surface could be observed. The captured content identifies a proxy failure rather than the approved application, so no endpoint, method (beyond attempted GET), query/body parameter, form, auth workflow, technology, JavaScript route, robots/sitemap, redirect, or additional HTTP(S) port can be attributed to the target. I did not register a disposable account because no application registration UI or API was reachable.

Raw command artifacts remain at `/workspace/surface-54680411/`: `httpx-default.jsonl`, `katana-http.jsonl`, `katana-https.jsonl`, the curl response bodies, and browser network/snapshot output.
